the_purple.title: Th' Purple
the_purple.description:
Download: %%download_link%%
Minecraft Java Edition Version: 1.21.9/10

Tis game requires pirates t' use a resource pack! Th' resource pack can be plundered on th' download page.

Follow us on Twitter: %twitter_link%
Join our Discord server: %discord_link%

Th' Purple be a fresh take on th' classic game o' tag. Explore alien seas, plunder unique treasures, n' avoid Th' Purple scurvy! In a unique twist, pirates never be truly eliminated. Spectators can affect th' gameplay, n' sometimes even rejoin th' game. With many maps, settin's, advancements, n' more, there always be something new to discover.

================================================

Map made by: Stuffy and nightlibra

Trailer made by: Blocky

Song: "Exoplanet" by Creo
